behavior_changes.before: aml-verifier-conformance-result/1 did not identify the exact external verifier challenge bytes or golden witness-vector bytes used by the harness
behavior_changes.after: aml-verifier-conformance-result/1 requires SHA-256 bindings for the exact external verifier challenge and golden witness-vector bytes and can be rechecked by the archived-result verifier

behavior_changes.before: golden valid, receipt-purpose tamper, challenge-nonce tamper, and expired challenge cases
behavior_changes.after: the same four verifier command cases, with stronger evidence metadata around the resulting report

notes: Snapshot 1 conformance result artifacts remain historical Snapshot 1 evidence. They are not upgraded or reinterpreted as Snapshot 2 results. Snapshot 2 adds exact challenge/vector byte binding because archived PASS/FAIL/MIXED evidence must identify the precise project-defined challenge it refers to.
